text:
ana_sales: Customer (MediCore) wants EU-only POC + clear cost and timeline. They gave prompt set + security questionnaire. Need recommended path and success criteria.

ryan_eng: Recommend hosted-eu for initial 2-week validation (fastest). Run their prompt suite to measure accuracy and latency. If throughput or p95 misses, propose dedicated reserved pool for steady-state. Private onsite only if legal requires.

zoe_ps: Proposed success metrics to share with procurement:
- Functional: >=90% on provided prompts (we define scoring rubric)
- Perf: p95 < 300ms for avg seq len 100 tokens
- Scale: sustain 300 RPS with <1% errors during 20m soak
- Cost: delta estimate hosted vs dedicated (will give ballpark)

tom_ops: Notes: hosted eu is immediate; dedicated provisioning ~2-4 weeks depending on GPU availability; private = longer. KV cache warmup + batching critical for p95. I'll draft an ops checklist for dedicated provisioning.

sec_bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/secq/MEDICORE-POC. Complete by mid-week to unblock dedicated/private planning.

ana_sales: Can we give a conservative monthly commit for dedicated?

ryan_eng: ballpark small dedicated pool ~€10k-€15k/month depending on GPUs. We'll include fallback routing: dedicated -> hosted with rate limiting.

zoe_ps: Timeline (4 weeks): W1 hosted baseline + security kickoff; W2 tuning & dedicated order if needed; W3 load tests; W4 handoff + procurement.

ana_sales: I'll send this summary to them and ask for confirmation + prompt clarifications. Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 CET.

ryan_eng: will prepare quick curl example and a one-page runbook for the hosted run.

tom_ops: will prepare monitoring dashboard items: token cost, per-route p95, cache hit ratio, and rollback plan.

zoe_ps: I'll draft the success criteria doc and procurement ballpark sheet.
